title: FAIRNESS AND BIAS IN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: A BRIEF SURVEY OF SOURCES, IMPACTS, AND MITIGATION STRATEGIES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through a systematic literature review of real-world case studies, including the COMPAS criminal justice system, healthcare patient mortality risk-scoring algorithms, and NIST studies on facial recognition technologies.

Evaluated via a literature review of historical and contemporary examples, such as AI recruitment tools penalizing women and generative AI text-to-image models producing stereotypical representations (e.g., predominantly male CEOs).
Assessed conceptually within the survey's discussion of algorithmic impacts on credit scoring systems and how they limit access to loans or mortgages for certain demographics.
